explanation: The Laws of Badminton fix the number. Goose or duck feathers are set in a cork base, which is why a shuttle always turns in flight to travel cork first.

claims.text: The Laws of Badminton require a feathered shuttle to have 16 feathers fixed in its base.
A feathered shuttle does not have 8, 12 or 24 feathers.
Shuttlecock feathers are usually goose or duck feathers set in a cork base.
A shuttlecock turns in flight so that its cork base leads.
